subject: art-design
source_note: Topic structure follows the CCEA A-Level Art & Design specification. Connections, sequence and prerequisites are expert-authored teaching relationships (exam boards do not publish these).

units.name: AS 2 — Personal Response
units.blurb: Resolving the AS theme into a personal response

topics.name: AO1 Develop ideas and connect to practitioners
topics.blurb: Developing ideas through investigation and the work of others

topics.name: AO2 Investigate and experiment with media
topics.blurb: Experimenting with media, materials, techniques and processes

topics.name: AO4 Present a personal response
topics.blurb: Presenting a personal and meaningful response

topics.name: Preparatory studies
topics.blurb: Developing the chosen theme through preparatory work

topics.name: Statement of Intent
topics.blurb: Statement linking the outcome to the A2 1 investigation

connections.why: Ideas developed from sources are tested by experimenting with media and processes
Experimentation is captured through recording observations and insights
Recorded ideas are selected and refined into the presented personal response
Investigating sources gives the observations that recording skills document
The portfolio's resolution skills carry directly into the AS personal response
Preparatory studies build the ideas the resolved response realises
Media experimentation feeds the preparatory studies of the personal response
AS resolution skills mature into the more focused A2 practical investigation
The practical investigation supplies the critical content analysed in the written investigation
Findings of the written investigation shape the Statement of Intent for the outcome
The investigation defines the theme the Statement of Intent commits to
The Statement of Intent directs the preparatory development of the thematic work
Preparatory development resolves into the final thematic outcome
Connecting to practitioners' work underpins the critical analysis in the written study
